subject: maths
question: A train is moving in from north to south direction. It overtakes Raj and Madhur who are walking in the same direction at the rate of 2 km/h and 4 km/h in 9 sec and 10 sec, respectively. If the train is x metres long, find the value of x.
solution:
**Given :**

Speed of Raj = 2km/h

Speed of Madhur = 4 km/h

Time taken to cross Raj = 9 s

Time taken to cross Madhur = 10 s

Length of the train = x m

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Let y (km/h) be the speed of the train.

(y - 2) × 5/18 × 9 = (y - 4) × 5/18 × 10

⇒ 9y - 18 = 10y - 40 

⇒ y = 22 km/h

Now, the length of the train = speed × time

⇒ (y - 2) × 5/18 × 9

⇒ (22 - 2) × 5/18 × 9

⇒ 20 × 5/2 = 50 m

**∴ The correct answer is 50 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Formula Used :**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation :**

Let the speed of the train is a m/s

Since, 1 km/h = 5/18 m/s

Hence, speed of Raj = 2 km/h = 5/9 m/s

And speed of Madhur = 4km/h = 10/9 m/s

When two objects are running in the same direction

Then, relative speed = Difference of speed

For Raj, a - (5)/(9) = (x)/(9)

⇒ a = (5)/(9) + (x)/(9) ---------(1)

For Madhur, a - (10)/(9) = (x)/(10)

⇒ (x)/(9) + (5)/(9) - (10)/(9) = (x)/(10) [putting the value of a from eq(1)]

⇒ (x)/(9) - (x)/(10) = (10)/(9) - (5)/(9)

⇒ (10x - 9x)/(90) = (10 - 5)/(9)

⇒ (x)/(90) = (5)/(9)

⇒ x = (5×90)/(9) = 50

**∴ Value of x = 50.**
